career_ladder.note: Qualifying the Subordinate Audit/Accounts Service (SAS) examination entitles departmental employees and confirms Direct Recruit Assistant Audit Officers (DR-AAOs) in the Indian Audit and Accounts Department (IA&AD) under the Comptroller and Auditor General of India. It marks the transition into the Gazetted officer cadre with non-functional upgradation to Level 9 after 4 years, followed by regular promotion to Senior Audit Officer (Level 10) and induction into the Indian Audit and Accounts Service (IA&AS).

exam_scheme.note: The Subordinate Audit/Accounts Service (SAS) Examination is conducted biannually (Exam-1 and Exam-2) in Computer Based Test (CBT) mode across IA&AD field offices. It comprises two stages: a preliminary screening test conducted by field offices (exempted for qualified Divisional Accountants) and the central Main Examination conducted by the Headquarters Examination Wing across Group-I (Common core papers) and Group-II (Branch-specialized papers, e.g. Civil Audit, Commercial Audit, Defence Audit, Railway Audit).

financial_package.pay_source_label: 7th Central Pay Commission Pay Matrix — Level 8 (₹47,600 - ₹1,51,100) for Assistant Audit/Accounts Officer (Group B Gazetted)
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level 8 entry basic pay of ₹47,600. Dearness Allowance at canonical 58% equals ₹27,608. House Rent Allowance ranges from ₹4,760 (10% in Z-class cities) to ₹14,280 (30% in X-class cities like New Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, Chennai). Transport Allowance is ₹5,688 (₹3,600 + 58% DA in higher TPTA cities) or ₹2,844 in other cities. Monthly deductions include NPS 10% (Basic + DA = ₹7,521), CGEGIS ₹60, CGHS ₹650, and income tax.
official_perks: Group 'B' Gazetted officer status in Government of India with statutory audit authority
Non-Functional Level 9 pay scale (₹53,100 - ₹1,67,800) automatically after 4 years regular service as AAO
Daily Allowance and traveling entitlement for outstation compliance and performance audit field tours
Government accommodation / General Pool Residential Accommodation (GPRA Type-IV) or HRA
Comprehensive medical coverage under Central Government Health Scheme (CGHS)
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and Children Education Allowance (CEA)
Defined contribution benefits under National Pension System (NPS) with 14% government contribution
